qEn: Which of the following is true regarding the AWS availability zones and edge locations?
qZh: 關於 AWS 可用區域和邊緣站點，下列哪項是正確的？
optionsEn: Edge locations are located in separate Availability Zones worldwide to serve global customers.
An availability zone exists within an edge location to distribute content globally with low latency.
An Availability Zone is a geographic location where AWS provides multiple, physically separated and isolated edge locations.
An AWS Availability Zone is an isolated location within an AWS Region, however edge locations are located in multiple cities worldwide.
optionsZh: 邊緣站點位於世界各地獨立的可用區域中，為全球客戶提供服務。
可用區域存在於邊緣站點內，以低延遲在全球分發內容。
可用區域是一個地理位置，AWS 在此提供多個實體分離且隔離的邊緣站點。
AWS 可用區域是 AWS 區域內的一個隔離位置，而邊緣站點則位於全球多個城市。
expEn: Availability Zones are distinct locations within an AWS Region that are engineered to be isolated from failures. Edge locations are much more numerous and are located in cities worldwide to cache content closer to end-users (CDN).
expZh: 可用區域是 AWS 區域內獨特的位置，其設計旨在與故障隔離。邊緣站點的數量要多得多，且位於全球各個城市，以將內容快取在更靠近終端使用者的位置 (CDN)。

qEn: Which features are included in the AWS Business Support Plan? (Choose TWO)
qZh: AWS 商業級支援計畫包含哪些功能？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: Access to Cloud Support Engineers via email only during business hours.
Access to the Infrastructure Event Management (IEM) feature for additional fee.
Partial access to the core Trusted Advisor checks.
optionsZh: 僅在營業時間內透過電子郵件聯絡雲端支援工程師。
需額外付費才能使用基礎設施事件管理 (IEM) 功能。
24x7 存取 TAM (技術客戶經理) 功能。
部分存取核心 Trusted Advisor 檢查。
expEn: The Business Support plan provides 24x7 access to customer service/Cloud Support Engineers via phone, email, and chat. IEM is available for an additional fee (it is included for free in Enterprise support).
expZh: 商業級支援計畫提供 24x7 透過電話、電子郵件和聊天存取客戶服務/雲端支援工程師。IEM 需額外付費才能使用（在企業級支援中為免費包含）。

qEn: A company is developing a mobile application and wants to allow users to use their Amazon, Apple, Facebook, or Google identities to authenticate to the application. Which AWS Service should the company use for this purpose?
qZh: 一家公司正在開發一款行動應用程式，並希望允許使用者使用其 Amazon、Apple、Facebook 或 Google 身分驗證至應用程式。公司應為此目的使用哪項 AWS 服務？
expEn: Amazon Cognito lets you add user sign-up, sign-in, and access control to your web and mobile apps quickly and easily. It supports sign-in with social identity providers, such as Facebook, Google, and Amazon.
expZh: Amazon Cognito 讓您可以快速輕鬆地為 Web 和行動應用程式新增使用者註冊、登入和存取控制。它支援使用社群身分提供者（如 Facebook、Google 和 Amazon）登入。

qEn: Which AWS Service allows customers to create a template that programmatically defines policies and configurations of all AWS resources as code and so that the same template can be reused among multiple projects?
qZh: 哪項 AWS 服務允許客戶建立一個範本，以程式碼形式對所有 AWS 資源的政策和設定進行程式化定義，從而使相同的範本可以在多個專案中重複使用？
expEn: AWS CloudFormation is the AWS service for 'Infrastructure as Code', allowing you to model and provision your AWS and third-party resources using a common language (JSON or YAML) template.
expZh: AWS CloudFormation 是適用於「基礎架構即程式碼」的 AWS 服務，允許您使用通用語言（JSON 或 YAML）範本來建立模型和佈建您的 AWS 和第三方資源。

qEn: Which of the following are advantages of using AWS as a cloud computing provider? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 使用 AWS 作為雲端運算供應商的優勢有哪些？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: Eliminates the need to monitor servers and applications.
Manages all the compliance and auditing tasks.
Provides custom hardware to meet any specification.
Eliminates the need to guess on infrastructure capacity needs.
Enables customers to trade their capital expenses for operational expenses.
optionsZh: 消除了監控伺服器和應用程式的需求。
管理所有合規性和稽核任務。
提供自訂硬體以滿足任何規格。
消除了猜測基礎架構容量需求的必要。
使客戶能將其資本支出轉換為營運支出。
expEn: Two major advantages of AWS cloud computing are 'Stop guessing capacity' (by using auto-scaling to match demand) and 'Trade capital expense for variable expense' (paying only for what you consume instead of buying data centers upfront).
expZh: AWS 雲端運算的兩大優勢是「停止猜測容量」（透過使用自動擴展來匹配需求）和「將資本支出轉為變動支出」（只為消耗的資源付費，而無需預先購買資料中心）。

qEn: A customer is planning to migrate their Microsoft SQL Server databases to AWS. Which AWS Services can the customer use to run their Microsoft SQL Server database on AWS? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 客戶計畫將其 Microsoft SQL Server 資料庫遷移至 AWS。客戶可以使用哪些 AWS 服務在 AWS 上執行其 Microsoft SQL Server 資料庫？（選擇兩個）
expEn: You can run SQL Server on AWS either as a fully managed service using Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS), or you can self-manage it by installing SQL Server on an Amazon EC2 instance.
expZh: 您可以在 AWS 上執行 SQL Server，可以將其作為使用 Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) 的全託管服務，也可以透過在 Amazon EC2 執行個體上安裝 SQL Server 來自行管理。

qEn: Which AWS Service can perform health checks on Amazon EC2 instances?
qZh: 哪項 AWS 服務可以對 Amazon EC2 執行個體執行健康檢查？
expEn: Amazon Route 53 can monitor the health and performance of your application as well as your web servers and other resources. You can configure DNS routing to route traffic away from an unhealthy EC2 instance.
expZh: Amazon Route 53 可以監控您的應用程式、Web 伺服器和其他資源的運作狀態和效能。您可以設定 DNS 路由，將流量從不健康的 EC2 執行個體引開。

qEn: A company is developing an application that will leverage facial recognition to automate photo tagging. Which AWS Service should the company use for facial recognition?
qZh: 一家公司正在開發一款應用程式，將利用臉部辨識來自動標記照片。該公司應使用哪項 AWS 服務進行臉部辨識？
expEn: Amazon Rekognition makes it easy to add highly accurate image and video analysis (including facial recognition and analysis) to your applications using proven, highly scalable, deep learning technology.
expZh: Amazon Rekognition 讓您能使用經過驗證、高度可擴展的深度學習技術，輕鬆地將高度準確的影像和影片分析（包括臉部辨識和分析）加入您的應用程式中。

qEn: Which of the following are examples of AWS-managed databases? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 下列哪些是 AWS 受管資料庫 (AWS-managed databases) 的範例？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: Microsoft SQL Server on Amazon EC2.
optionsZh: 在 Amazon EC2 上的 Microsoft SQL Server。
在 Amazon EC2 上的 MySQL。
expEn: Amazon Neptune (graph database) and Amazon RDS (relational database) are fully managed database services. Running a database directly on EC2 requires you to self-manage the database software and OS.
expZh: Amazon Neptune（圖形資料庫）和 Amazon RDS（關聯式資料庫）是全託管資料庫服務。直接在 EC2 上執行資料庫需要您自行管理資料庫軟體和作業系統。

qEn: A company’s AWS workflow requires that it periodically perform large-scale image and video processing jobs. The customer is seeking to minimize cost and has stated that the amount of time it takes to process these jobs is not critical, but that cost minimization is the most important factor in designing the solution. Which EC2 instance class is best suited for this processing?
qZh: 一家公司的 AWS 工作流程要求其定期執行大規模的影像和影片處理工作。客戶尋求將成本降至最低，並表示處理這些工作所需的時間並不關鍵，但成本最小化是設計解決方案的最重要因素。哪種 EC2 執行個體類別最適合此處理程序？
optionsZh: EC2 預留執行個體 - 無預付。
EC2 競價型執行個體 (Spot Instances)。
EC2 預留執行個體 - 全額預付。
expEn: Because the processing time is not critical (meaning the jobs are fault-tolerant and can be interrupted and resumed later), Spot Instances offer the largest cost savings (up to 90% discount) for this workload.
expZh: 由於處理時間並不關鍵（這意味著任務是容錯的，可以被中斷並在稍後恢復），因此對於此工作負載，競價型執行個體可節省最大的成本（高達 90% 的折扣）。

qEn: There is a requirement to grant a DevOps team full administrative access to all resources in an AWS account. Who can grant them these permissions?
qZh: 有一項需求是授予 DevOps 團隊對 AWS 帳戶中所有資源的完全管理存取權限。誰能授予他們這些權限？
expEn: The AWS account owner (specifically the root user or an administrator with sufficient IAM privileges created by the root user) is the only entity that can grant administrative access within their own account.
expZh: AWS 帳戶擁有者（特別是根使用者，或由根使用者建立、具有足夠 IAM 權限的管理員）是唯一可以在其自己帳戶內授予管理員存取權限的實體。

qEn: You need to migrate a large number of on-premises workloads to AWS. Which AWS service is the most appropriate?
qZh: 您需要將大量的本地端工作負載遷移到 AWS。哪項 AWS 服務最合適？
optionsZh: AWS 檔案傳輸加速 (File Transfer Acceleration)。
AWS 伺服器遷移服務 (Server Migration Service, SMS)。
expEn: AWS Server Migration Service (SMS) is an agentless service which makes it easier and faster for you to migrate thousands of on-premises workloads to AWS.
expZh: AWS 伺服器遷移服務 (SMS) 是一種無代理程式服務，可讓您更輕鬆、更快速地將數千個本地端工作負載遷移至 AWS。

qEn: What are some key benefits of using AWS CloudFormation? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 使用 AWS CloudFormation 的一些主要好處是什麼？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: It helps AWS customers deploy their applications without worrying about the underlying infrastructure.
It applies advanced IAM security features automatically.
It automates the provisioning and updating of your infrastructure in a safe and controlled manner.
It allows you to model your entire infrastructure in just a text file.
It compiles and builds application code in a timely manner.
optionsZh: 它幫助 AWS 客戶部署其應用程式，而無需擔心底層基礎架構。
它會自動套用進階的 IAM 安全功能。
它以安全且受控的方式自動化基礎架構的配置和更新。
它允許您僅在文字檔中為整個基礎架構建立模型。
它及時編譯並建置應用程式碼。
expEn: AWS CloudFormation allows you to treat your infrastructure as code (modeling it in a JSON/YAML text file) and automates the provisioning of that infrastructure in a safe, repeatable manner.
expZh: AWS CloudFormation 讓您能將基礎架構視為程式碼（在 JSON/YAML 文字檔中建立模型），並以安全、可重複的方式自動配置該基礎架構。

qEn: Which of the following is a cloud computing deployment model that connects infrastructure and applications between cloud-based resources and existing resources not located in the cloud?
qZh: 下列哪種雲端運算部署模型可連接雲端資源和不在雲端中的現有資源之間的基礎架構和應用程式？
expEn: A hybrid deployment connects infrastructure and applications between cloud-based resources and existing resources that are not located in the cloud (such as on-premises data centers).
expZh: 混合式部署連接了雲端資源與不在雲端（例如本地資料中心）的現有資源之間的基礎架構和應用程式。

qEn: A company is hosting business critical workloads in an AWS Region. To protect against data loss and ensure business continuity, a mirror image of the current AWS environment should be created in another AWS Region. Company policy requires that the standby environment must be available in minutes in case of an outage in the primary AWS Region. Which AWS service can be used to meet these requirements?
qZh: 一家公司在 AWS 區域託管關鍵業務工作負載。為了防止資料遺失並確保業務連續性，應在另一個 AWS 區域建立目前 AWS 環境的鏡像。公司政策要求，如果主要 AWS 區域發生中斷，備用環境必須在數分鐘內可用。可以使用哪項 AWS 服務來滿足這些需求？
optionsZh: CloudEndure Disaster Recovery (AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery)。
expEn: CloudEndure Disaster Recovery (now heavily integrated as AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery) minimizes downtime and data loss by providing fast, reliable recovery of physical, virtual, and cloud-based servers into AWS.
expZh: CloudEndure Disaster Recovery（現在深度整合為 AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery）透過將實體、虛擬和雲端伺服器快速、可靠地復原到 AWS，將停機時間和資料遺失降至最低。

qEn: Which of the following S3 storage classes is most appropriate to host static assets for a popular e-commerce website with stable access patterns?
qZh: 下列哪種 S3 儲存類別最適合為存取模式穩定的熱門電子商務網站託管靜態資產？
optionsZh: S3 Standard-IA (標準 - 不常存取)。
expEn: For a popular website with stable, frequent access patterns, S3 Standard is the most appropriate storage class because it provides high durability, availability, and performance for frequently accessed data.
expZh: 對於存取模式穩定且頻繁的熱門網站，S3 Standard 是最合適的儲存類別，因為它為頻繁存取的資料提供了高耐久性、可用性和效能。

qEn: You want to create a backup of your data in another geographical location. Where should you create this backup?
qZh: 您希望在另一個地理位置建立資料備份。您應該在哪裡建立此備份？
expEn: AWS Regions are completely separate geographic locations. Creating a backup in another Region protects against a large-scale disaster affecting an entire geographic area.
expZh: AWS 區域是完全獨立的地理位置。在另一個區域建立備份可以防止影響整個地理區域的大規模災難。

qEn: Which statement is true in relation to the security of Amazon EC2?
qZh: 關於 Amazon EC2 的安全，哪項敘述是正確的？
optionsEn: You should use instance store volumes to store login data.
You should regularly patch the operating system and applications on your EC2 instances.
You should deploy critical components of your application in the Availability Zone that you trust.
You can track all API calls using Amazon Athena.
optionsZh: 您應該使用執行個體存放區磁碟區來儲存登入資料。
您應該定期修補 EC2 執行個體上的作業系統和應用程式。
您應該將應用程式的關鍵組件部署在您信任的可用區域中。
您可以使用 Amazon Athena 追蹤所有 API 呼叫。
expEn: Under the Shared Responsibility Model, the customer is responsible for patching and managing the guest operating system and any installed applications on Amazon EC2 instances.
expZh: 在責任共擔模型下，客戶負責修補和管理客體作業系統以及在 Amazon EC2 執行個體上安裝的任何應用程式。

qEn: What does AWS Cost Explorer provide to help manage your AWS spend?
qZh: AWS Cost Explorer 提供什麼來協助管理您的 AWS 支出？
optionsEn: Cost comparisons between AWS Cloud environments and on-premises environments.
Accurate estimates of AWS service costs based on your expected usage.
Highly accurate cost forecasts for up to 12 months ahead.
optionsZh: AWS 雲端環境與本地端環境之間的成本比較。
根據您的預期用量準確估算 AWS 服務成本。
提供未來長達 12 個月的高度準確的成本預測。
expEn: AWS Cost Explorer lets you visualize, understand, and manage your AWS costs and usage over time, and it can provide cost forecasts for up to 12 months in the future based on your historical usage.
expZh: AWS Cost Explorer 讓您可以隨時間推移視覺化、了解和管理您的 AWS 成本和用量，並且它可以根據您的歷史用量提供未來長達 12 個月的成本預測。

qEn: Which of the following is a feature of Amazon RDS that performs automatic failover when the primary database fails to respond?
qZh: 下列哪項是 Amazon RDS 的功能，當主資料庫無法回應時會執行自動容錯移轉？
expEn: In an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ deployment, Amazon RDS automatically provisions and maintains a synchronous standby replica in a different Availability Zone. If the primary DB instance fails, RDS automatically fails over to the standby.
expZh: 在 Amazon RDS 多可用區域部署中，Amazon RDS 會在不同的可用區域中自動佈建並維護一個同步的備用複本。如果主資料庫執行個體故障，RDS 會自動容錯移轉至備用執行個體。

qEn: You are using several on-demand EC2 Instances to run your development environment. What is the best way to reduce your charges when these instances are not in use?
qZh: 您正在使用幾個按需 EC2 執行個體來執行您的開發環境。當這些執行個體未使用時，減少費用的最佳方法是什麼？
optionsEn: Deleting all EBS volumes attached to the instances.
You cannot minimize charges for on-demand instances.
optionsZh: 刪除連接到執行個體的所有 EBS 磁碟區。
您無法將按需執行個體的費用降至最低。
expEn: For a development environment that you will need again, stopping the EC2 instances ensures you are not billed for compute time while they are not running. (You will still pay a small amount for the attached EBS storage).
expZh: 對於您會再次需要的開發環境，停止 EC2 執行個體可確保在它們未執行時您不會被收取運算時間的費用。（您仍需為連接的 EBS 儲存空間支付少量費用）。

qEn: Which of the following strategies helps protect your AWS root account?
qZh: 下列哪種策略有助於保護您的 AWS 根帳戶？
optionsEn: Delete root user access keys if you do not need them.
Apply MFA for the root account and use it for all of your work.
Access the root account only from your personal Mobile Phone.
Only share your AWS account password or access keys with trusted persons.
optionsZh: 如果您不需要，請刪除根使用者存取金鑰。
為根帳戶套用 MFA 並將其用於您所有的工作。
僅從您的個人手機存取根帳戶。
只與受信任的人分享您的 AWS 帳戶密碼或存取金鑰。
expEn: Best practices for the root account include locking away the root credentials, enabling MFA, NOT using it for daily work, and deleting root access keys to prevent programmatic access by the root user.
expZh: 根帳戶的最佳實踐包括：妥善保管根憑證、啟用 MFA、不要將其用於日常工作，以及刪除根存取金鑰以防止根使用者進行程式化存取。

qEn: Which of the following are factors should be considered for Amazon EBS pricing? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 考量 Amazon EBS 定價時，應將下列哪些因素納入考量？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: The size of volumes provisioned per month.
The amount of data you have stored in snapshots.
The number of Snowball storage devices you request.
optionsZh: 每月配置的磁碟區大小。
您儲存在快照中的資料量。
您請求的 Snowball 儲存裝置數量。
expEn: Amazon EBS pricing is primarily based on the amount of storage provisioned for volumes (GB per month) and the storage consumed by EBS snapshots.
expZh: Amazon EBS 定價主要基於為磁碟區配置的儲存量（每月 GB）以及 EBS 快照所消耗的儲存量。

qEn: You have just set up your AWS environment and have created six IAM user accounts for the DevOps team. What is the AWS recommendation when granting permissions to these IAM accounts?
qZh: 您剛設定好 AWS 環境，並為 DevOps 團隊建立了六個 IAM 使用者帳戶。在授予這些 IAM 帳戶權限時，AWS 的建議是什麼？
optionsEn: Attach a separate IAM policy for each individual account.
Apply the Principle of Least Privilege.
For security purposes, you should not grant any permission to the DevOps team.
optionsZh: 為每個獨立帳戶附加單獨的 IAM 政策。
套用最小權限原則 (Principle of Least Privilege)。
出於安全考量，您不應授予 DevOps 團隊任何權限。
建立六個不同的 IAM 密碼。
expEn: The Principle of Least Privilege means granting users only the permissions they need to perform their jobs, which is a foundational security best practice in IAM.
expZh: 最小權限原則意味著僅授予使用者執行其工作所需的權限，這是 IAM 中的基礎安全最佳實踐。

qEn: Which of the following has the greatest impact on cost? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 下列哪項對成本的影響最大？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: The number of IAM roles provisioned.
optionsZh: 資料傳入 (Data Transfer In) 費用。
資料傳出 (Data Transfer Out) 費用。
配置的 IAM 角色數量。
expEn: In AWS, the three fundamental drivers of cost are compute (EC2), storage (S3, EBS), and outbound data transfer (Data Transfer Out). Data Transfer In to AWS is generally free.
expZh: 在 AWS 中，成本的三個基本驅動因素是運算 (EC2)、儲存 (S3, EBS) 和對外的資料傳輸 (Data Transfer Out)。傳入 AWS 的資料傳輸 (Data Transfer In) 通常是免費的。

qEn: Who from the following will get the largest discount?
qZh: 下列哪一位將獲得最大的折扣？
optionsEn: A user who chooses to buy On-demand, Convertible, Partial upfront instances.
A user who chooses to buy Reserved, Convertible, All upfront instances.
A user who chooses to buy Reserved, Standard, No upfront instances.
A user who chooses to buy Reserved, Standard, All upfront instances.
optionsZh: 選擇購買按需、可轉換、部分預付執行個體的使用者。
選擇購買預留、可轉換、全額預付執行個體的使用者。
選擇購買預留、標準、無預付執行個體的使用者。
選擇購買預留、標準、全額預付執行個體的使用者。
expEn: For Reserved Instances, the 'Standard' class offers a larger discount than 'Convertible'. Furthermore, the 'All Upfront' payment option provides a larger discount than Partial or No Upfront.
expZh: 對於預留執行個體，「標準 (Standard)」類別提供的折扣大於「可轉換 (Convertible)」。此外，「全額預付 (All Upfront)」付款選項提供的折扣大於部分預付或無預付。

qEn: Which of the following is an available option when purchasing Amazon EC2 instances?
qZh: 購買 Amazon EC2 執行個體時，下列哪一項是可用的選項？
optionsEn: The ability to bid to get the lowest possible prices.
The ability to register EC2 instances to get volume discounts on every hour the instances are running.
The ability to buy Dedicated Instances for up to 90% discount.
The ability to pay upfront to get lower hourly costs.
optionsZh: 透過競標獲得最低價格的能力。
註冊 EC2 執行個體以在執行個體執行的每個小時獲得數量折扣的能力。
以高達 90% 的折扣購買專用執行個體的能力。
預付費用以降低每小時成本的能力。
expEn: Purchasing Reserved Instances allows you to pay upfront (partially or fully) in exchange for significantly lower hourly compute costs compared to On-Demand pricing.
expZh: 購買預留執行個體允許您預付費用（部分或全部），以換取與按需定價相比顯著降低的每小時運算成本。

qEn: What does the term “Economies of scale” mean?
qZh: 「規模經濟 (Economies of scale)」一詞是什麼意思？
optionsEn: It means that you save more when you consume more.
It means as more time passes using AWS, you pay more for its services.
It means that AWS will continuously lower costs as it grows.
It means that you have the ability to pay as you go.
optionsZh: 這意味著當您消耗更多時，您會節省更多。
這意味著隨著使用 AWS 的時間越長，您為其服務支付的費用就越多。
這意味著 AWS 將隨著其成長而不斷降低成本。
這意味著您擁有隨收隨付的能力。
expEn: In cloud computing, massive economies of scale refer to AWS achieving lower variable costs through hundreds of thousands of customers aggregating usage, passing those savings on to customers in the form of lower prices.
expZh: 在雲端運算中，巨大的規模經濟是指 AWS 透過數十萬客戶彙整的使用量來實現較低的變動成本，並以較低價格的形式將這些節省下來的成本回饋給客戶。

qEn: A company experiences fluctuations in traffic patterns to their e-commerce website when running flash sales. What service can help the company dynamically match the required compute capacity to handle spikes in traffic during flash sales?
qZh: 一家公司在舉辦限時搶購時，其電子商務網站的流量模式會出現波動。哪項服務可以協助公司動態匹配所需的運算容量，以處理限時搶購期間流量激增的情況？
expEn: AWS Auto Scaling monitors your applications and automatically adjusts capacity to maintain steady, predictable performance at the lowest possible cost, scaling out during traffic spikes.
expZh: AWS Auto Scaling 監控您的應用程式並自動調整容量，以盡可能低的成本維持穩定、可預測的效能，並在流量激增時向外擴展。

qEn: Which of the below options is true of Amazon VPC?
qZh: 關於 Amazon VPC，下列哪個選項是正確的？
optionsEn: Amazon VPC allows customers to control user interactions with all other AWS resources.
AWS Customers have complete control over their Amazon VPC virtual networking environment.
AWS is responsible for all the management and configuration details of Amazon VPC.
Amazon VPC helps customers to review their AWS architecture and adopt best practices.
optionsZh: Amazon VPC 允許客戶控制使用者與所有其他 AWS 資源的互動。
AWS 客戶對其 Amazon VPC 虛擬網路環境擁有完全的控制權。
AWS 負責 Amazon VPC 的所有管理和組態設定細節。
Amazon VPC 協助客戶審查其 AWS 架構並採用最佳實踐。
expEn: Amazon VPC lets you provision a logically isolated section of the AWS Cloud where you have complete control over your virtual networking environment, including selection of your own IP address range, creation of subnets, and configuration of route tables and network gateways.
expZh: Amazon VPC 讓您可以配置 AWS 雲端中邏輯隔離的部分，在該部分您對虛擬網路環境擁有完全的控制權，包括選擇您自己的 IP 位址範圍、建立子網路以及設定路由表和網路閘道。

qEn: Which tool can a non-AWS customer use to compare the cost of on-premises environment resources to AWS?
qZh: 非 AWS 客戶可以使用哪種工具來比較本地端環境資源與 AWS 的成本？
expEn: The AWS Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) Calculator (often supported by AWS Migration Evaluator) helps prospective customers compare the cost of running their applications in an on-premises or colocation environment to AWS.
expZh: AWS 總體擁有成本 (TCO) 計算機（通常由 AWS Migration Evaluator 支援）協助潛在客戶比較在本地或主機代管環境與 AWS 中執行應用程式的成本。

qEn: Which of the following services provide real-time auditing for compliance and vulnerabilities? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 下列哪些服務提供針對合規性和漏洞的即時稽核？（選擇兩個）
expEn: AWS Config continuously monitors and records your AWS resource configurations to automate the evaluation of recorded configurations against desired configurations (compliance). AWS Trusted Advisor audits your environment in real-time to check for security vulnerabilities and best practices.
expZh: AWS Config 持續監控並記錄您的 AWS 資源組態，以自動化對記錄組態和預期組態（合規性）的評估。AWS Trusted Advisor 即時稽核您的環境，以檢查安全漏洞和最佳實踐。

qEn: Which of the following AWS services uses Puppet to automate how EC2 instances are configured?
qZh: 下列哪項 AWS 服務使用 Puppet 來自動化 EC2 執行個體的設定方式？
expEn: AWS OpsWorks is a configuration management service that provides managed instances of Chef and Puppet to automate how servers are configured, deployed, and managed.
expZh: AWS OpsWorks 是一種組態管理服務，提供受管的 Chef 和 Puppet 執行個體，以自動化伺服器設定、部署和管理的方式。

qEn: An organization uses a hybrid cloud architecture to run their business. Which AWS service enables them to deploy their applications to any AWS or on-premises server?
qZh: 一個組織使用混合雲架構來經營其業務。哪項 AWS 服務使他們能夠將應用程式部署到任何 AWS 或本地端伺服器？
expEn: AWS CodeDeploy automates code deployments to any instance, including Amazon EC2 instances and instances running on-premises.
expZh: AWS CodeDeploy 自動化程式碼部署至任何執行個體，包括 Amazon EC2 執行個體和本地執行的執行個體。

qEn: Select the services that are server-based: (Choose TWO)
qZh: 選擇基於伺服器 (server-based) 的服務：（選擇兩個）
expEn: Amazon RDS runs on underlying EC2 instances that you configure (though managed by AWS). Amazon EMR uses a cluster of EC2 instances. DynamoDB, Lambda, and Fargate are serverless technologies where the underlying infrastructure is hidden.
expZh: Amazon RDS 執行在您設定的底層 EC2 執行個體上（儘管由 AWS 管理）。Amazon EMR 使用 EC2 執行個體叢集。DynamoDB、Lambda 和 Fargate 都是隱藏了底層基礎架構的無伺服器技術。

qEn: What best describes penetration testing?
qZh: 哪項最能描述滲透測試 (penetration testing)？
optionsEn: Testing your application’s response time from different locations.
Testing your network to find security vulnerabilities that an attacker could exploit.
Testing your instances to check for the unhealthy ones.
Testing your software for bugs and errors.
optionsZh: 從不同位置測試應用程式的回應時間。
測試您的網路以找出攻擊者可能利用的安全漏洞。
測試您的執行個體以檢查不健康的執行個體。
測試您的軟體是否存在錯誤 (bugs)。
expEn: Penetration testing is an authorized simulated cyberattack on a computer system, performed to evaluate the security of the system and find vulnerabilities that an attacker could exploit.
expZh: 滲透測試是一種經過授權、在電腦系統上進行的模擬網路攻擊，執行目的是為了評估系統的安全性，並找出攻擊者可能利用的漏洞。

qEn: Which of the following are use cases for Amazon EMR? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 下列哪些是 Amazon EMR 的使用案例？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: Enables you to backup extremely large amounts of data at very low costs.
Enables you to move Exabyte-scale data from on-premises datacenters into AWS.
Enables you to analyze and process extremely large amounts of data in a timely manner.
Enables you to easily run and scale Apache Spark, Hadoop,and other Big Data frameworks.
Enables you to easily run and manage Docker containers.
optionsZh: 使您能以極低的成本備份極大量的資料。
使您能將 Exabyte 等級的資料從本地資料中心移入 AWS。
使您能及時分析和處理極大量的資料。
使您能輕鬆執行和擴展 Apache Spark、Hadoop 和其他大數據框架。
使您能輕鬆執行和管理 Docker 容器。
expEn: Amazon EMR is the industry-leading cloud big data platform for processing vast amounts of data using open source tools such as Apache Spark, Apache Hive, Apache HBase, Apache Flink, Apache Hudi, and Presto.
expZh: Amazon EMR 是領先業界的雲端大數據平台，用於使用開源工具（如 Apache Spark、Apache Hive、Apache HBase、Apache Flink、Apache Hudi 和 Presto）處理海量資料。

qEn: Your CTO has asked you to contact AWS support using the chat feature to ask for guidance related to EBS. However, when you open the AWS support center you can't see a way to contact support via Chat. What should you do?
qZh: 您的技術長 (CTO) 要求您使用聊天功能聯絡 AWS 支援，以尋求與 EBS 相關的指引。但是，當您開啟 AWS 支援中心時，卻看不到透過聊天聯絡支援的方法。您該怎麼做？
optionsEn: There is no chat feature in AWS support.
The chat feature is available for all plans for an additional fee, but you have to request it first.
At a minimum, upgrade to Business support plan.
Upgrade from the Basic Support plan to Developer Support.
optionsZh: AWS 支援中沒有聊天功能。
聊天功能適用於所有計畫，但需額外付費，且您必須先提出申請。
至少升級到商業級 (Business) 支援計畫。
從基本支援計畫升級到開發人員支援。
expEn: Access to Cloud Support Engineers via phone, chat, and email is available starting with the Business Support plan. Basic and Developer plans do not include chat support.
expZh: 從商業級支援計畫開始，才可透過電話、聊天和電子郵件聯絡雲端支援工程師。基本和開發人員計畫不包含聊天支援。

qEn: A developer wants to quickly deploy and manage his application in the AWS Cloud, but he doesn’t have any experience with cloud computing. Which of the following AWS services would help the developer achieve his goal?
qZh: 開發人員希望在 AWS 雲端中快速部署和管理他的應用程式，但他沒有任何雲端運算經驗。下列哪項 AWS 服務有助於開發人員達成其目標？
expEn: AWS Elastic Beanstalk is an easy-to-use PaaS service for deploying and scaling web applications. You simply upload your code, and Elastic Beanstalk automatically handles the deployment, from capacity provisioning to load balancing and auto-scaling.
expZh: AWS Elastic Beanstalk 是一項易於使用的 PaaS 服務，用於部署和擴展 Web 應用程式。您只需上傳程式碼，Elastic Beanstalk 就會自動處理部署，從容量佈建、負載平衡到自動擴展。

qEn: Which statement best describes the AWS Pay-As-You-Go pricing model?
qZh: 哪項敘述最能描述 AWS 隨收隨付 (Pay-As-You-Go) 定價模型？
optionsEn: With AWS, you replace low upfront expenses with large variable payments.
With AWS, you replace low upfront expenses with large fixed payments.
With AWS, you replace large upfront expenses with low fixed payments.
With AWS, you replace large capital expenses with low variable payments.
optionsZh: 透過 AWS，您用大額的變動付款取代了低額的預付費用。
透過 AWS，您用大額的固定付款取代了低額的預付費用。
透過 AWS，您用低額的固定付款取代了大額的預付費用。
透過 AWS，您用較低的變動付款 (variable payments) 取代了大額的資本支出 (capital expenses)。
expEn: Pay-as-you-go pricing allows you to easily adapt to changing business needs without overcommitting budgets. You trade large capital expense (buying data centers) for variable expense (paying for what you use).
expZh: 隨收隨付定價讓您能輕鬆適應不斷變化的業務需求，而不會過度承諾預算。您將大量資本支出（購買資料中心）換成了變動支出（為所用資源付費）。

qEn: For Amazon RDS databases, what does AWS perform on your behalf? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 對於 Amazon RDS 資料庫，AWS 會代表您執行什麼？（選擇兩個）
optionsZh: 作業系統管理 (Management of the operating system)。
expEn: Amazon RDS is a managed service where AWS automates time-consuming administration tasks such as hardware provisioning, database setup, patching the operating system and database engine, and backups.
expZh: Amazon RDS 是一項受管服務，AWS 會自動化耗時的管理任務，例如硬體佈建、資料庫設定、修補作業系統和資料庫引擎以及備份。

qEn: Which of the following strategies help analyze costs in AWS?
qZh: 下列哪種策略有助於分析 AWS 中的成本？
optionsEn: Using AWS CloudFormation to automate the deployment of resources.
Deploying resources of the same type in different regions.
Configuring Amazon Inspector to automatically analyze costs and email reports.
optionsZh: 使用標籤 (tags) 來分組資源。
使用 AWS CloudFormation 自動化資源部署。
在不同區域部署同類型的資源。
設定 Amazon Inspector 自動分析成本並傳送電子郵件報告。
expEn: Tags (key-value pairs) allow you to categorize your AWS resources in different ways, for example, by purpose, owner, or environment. Cost Allocation Tags are essential for tracking AWS costs on a detailed level.
expZh: 標籤（鍵值對）讓您可以用不同方式對 AWS 資源進行分類，例如按目的、擁有者或環境。成本分配標籤對於在詳細層級追蹤 AWS 成本至關重要。

qEn: A media company has an application that requires the transfer of large data sets to and from AWS every day. This data is business critical and should be transferred over a consistent connection. Which AWS service should the company use?
qZh: 一家媒體公司有一個應用程式需要每天在 AWS 之間傳輸大型資料集。這些資料對業務至關重要，且應透過穩定的連線進行傳輸。公司應使用哪項 AWS 服務？
expEn: AWS Direct Connect bypasses the public internet and establishes a dedicated, private network connection from your premises to AWS, providing a more consistent and reliable network experience for transferring large daily data sets.
expZh: AWS Direct Connect 繞過公共網際網路，建立從您的本地端到 AWS 的專用私有網路連線，為日常傳輸大型資料集提供更穩定可靠的網路體驗。

qEn: What is the main benefit of the AWS Storage Gateway service?
qZh: AWS Storage Gateway 服務的主要好處是什麼？
optionsEn: It automates the process of building, maintaining, and running ETL jobs.
It provides physical devices to migrate data from on premises to AWS.
It allows integration of on-premises IT environments with Cloud Storage.
It provides hardware-based key storage for regulatory compliance.
optionsZh: 它自動化建立、維護和執行 ETL 工作程序的過程。
它提供實體裝置以將資料從本地端遷移至 AWS。
它允許將本地 IT 環境與雲端儲存 (Cloud Storage) 整合。
它提供基於硬體的金鑰儲存以滿足法規遵循。
expEn: AWS Storage Gateway is a hybrid cloud storage service that gives you on-premises access to virtually unlimited cloud storage, bridging the gap between your local IT environment and AWS storage.
expZh: AWS Storage Gateway 是一種混合雲儲存服務，讓您能在本地存取幾乎無限的雲端儲存空間，彌合了您的本機 IT 環境與 AWS 儲存之間的差距。

qEn: To protect against data loss, you need to backup your database regularly. What is the most cost-effective storage option that provides immediate retrieval of your backups?
qZh: 為了防止資料遺失，您需要定期備份資料庫。哪種最具成本效益的儲存選項可提供備份的立即檢索？
optionsZh: Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (標準 - 不常存取)。
expEn: While Glacier is cheaper, it requires hours to retrieve data. S3 Standard-IA is cost-effective for data that is accessed less frequently (like backups) but requires rapid access (milliseconds) when needed.
expZh: 雖然 Glacier 更便宜，但需要數小時才能檢索資料。S3 Standard-IA 對於存取頻率較低（如備份）但需要時可快速存取（毫秒級）的資料具成本效益。

qEn: Which service can you use to route traffic to the endpoint that provides the best application performance for your users worldwide?
qZh: 您可以使用哪項服務將流量路由到能為全球使用者提供最佳應用程式效能的端點？
expEn: AWS Global Accelerator is a networking service that routes your user traffic through Amazon's global network infrastructure, improving internet user performance and availability by directing traffic to the optimal endpoint.
expZh: AWS Global Accelerator 是一項網路服務，透過 Amazon 的全球網路基礎架構路由使用者流量，藉由將流量導向最佳端點來提高網際網路使用者的效能和可用性。

qEn: Why are Serverless Architectures more economical than Server-based Architectures?
qZh: 為什麼無伺服器 (Serverless) 架構比基於伺服器的架構更經濟？
optionsEn: Serverless Architectures use new powerful computing devices.
With the Server-based Architectures, compute resources continue to run all the time but with serverless architecture, compute resources are only used when code is being executed.
When you reserve serverless capacity, you will get large discounts compared to server reservation.
With Serverless Architectures you have the ability to scale automatically up or down as demand changes.
optionsZh: 無伺服器架構使用功能強大的新型運算裝置。
在基於伺服器的架構中，運算資源會一直持續執行；而在無伺服器架構中，運算資源僅在程式碼執行時才被使用。
當您預留無伺服器容量時，與伺服器預留相比將獲得大額折扣。
借助無伺服器架構，您能夠隨著需求變化自動向上或向下擴展。
expEn: In a serverless architecture (like AWS Lambda), you pay only for the compute time you consume. There is no charge when your code is not running, eliminating the cost of idle server time.
expZh: 在無伺服器架構（如 AWS Lambda）中，您只需為消耗的運算時間付費。當您的程式碼未執行時不收費，從而消除了伺服器閒置時間的成本。

qEn: Which of the below options are use cases of the Amazon Route 53 service? (Choose TWO)
qZh: 下列哪些選項是 Amazon Route 53 服務的使用案例？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: Point-to-point connectivity between an on-premises data center and AWS.
Detects configuration changes in the AWS environment.
Manages global application traffic through a variety of routing types.
optionsZh: 本地資料中心與 AWS 之間的點對點連線。
偵測 AWS 環境中的組態變更。
透過各種路由類型管理全球應用程式流量。
提供基礎架構安全最佳化建議。
expEn: Amazon Route 53 is a highly available and scalable cloud Domain Name System (DNS) web service. It translates domain names to IPs and uses health checks to route global traffic via various routing policies (e.g., latency, weighted).
expZh: Amazon Route 53 是一種高可用性且可擴展的雲端網域名稱系統 (DNS) Web 服務。它將網域名稱轉換為 IP，並使用健康檢查透過各種路由政策（例如延遲、加權）路由全球流量。

qEn: You want to transfer 200 Terabytes of data from on-premises locations to the AWS Cloud, which of the following can do the job in a cost-effective way?
qZh: 您想將 200 TB (Terabytes) 的資料從本地端傳輸到 AWS 雲端，下列哪一項可以用具成本效益的方式完成這項工作？
expEn: AWS Snowball is a petabyte-scale data transport solution that uses devices designed to be secure to transfer large amounts of data into and out of the AWS Cloud cost-effectively. (Snowmobile is for Exabytes, DMS is for databases).
expZh: AWS Snowball 是一種 PB (Petabyte) 等級的資料傳輸解決方案，它使用專為安全設計的裝置，具成本效益地將大量資料傳入和傳出 AWS 雲端。（Snowmobile 適用於 EB 級，DMS 適用於資料庫）。

qEn: You have a real-time IoT application that requires sub-millisecond latency. Which of the following services should you use?
qZh: 您有一個需要次毫秒級 (sub-millisecond) 延遲的即時 IoT 應用程式。您應該使用下列哪項服務？
expEn: Amazon ElastiCache for Redis is an in-memory data store that delivers sub-millisecond latency to power internet-scale real-time applications like IoT, gaming, and ad-tech.
expZh: Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 是一個記憶體內資料存放區，提供次毫秒級的延遲，為 IoT、遊戲和廣告科技等網際網路規模的即時應用程式提供動力。
